title: ReasonMed: A 370K Multi-Agent Generated Dataset for Advancing Medical Reasoning
authors_zh: Yu Sun、Xingyu Qian、Weiwen Xu、Hao Zhang、Chenghao Xiao、Long Li、Deli Zhao、Wenbing Huang、Tingyang Xu、Qifeng Bai、Yu Rong
paper_type_zh: 医学推理数据发布与多教师难度路由构造配方
best_for_zh: 关注医学推理 SFT、多教师生成、LLM 判定器、难度路由、专家审计与高风险数据治理的研究者
one_line: Routes nine candidate paths per medical MCQ through answer-key-conditioned verification and easy/medium/difficult repair, then releases three unequal SFT views totaling 1,111,555 rows.
每道医学选择题拟生成九条路径，经答案键条件下的验证与难度路由修复后，发布三套不等长的 SFT 视图，共 1,111,555 行。
why: Provides a concrete high-risk-domain construction recipe whose open rows also expose judge dependence, missing lineage, count reconciliation, and medical-validity limits.
inclusion_reason: Releases three medical-reasoning SFT formulations and an explicit multi-teacher, answer-key verification, difficulty-routing, refinement, and regeneration recipe.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Medical reasoning SFT needs more than a correct multiple-choice letter: a useful record should explain clinical factors and reject distractors without adding unsupported medical claims. Single-teacher distillation can repeat one model's knowledge gaps, while exhaustive generation with the strongest proprietary model is expensive. ReasonMed asks whether complementary teachers, answer-key-conditioned judging, and difficulty-dependent repair can produce a large open reasoning corpus at lower cost.

The audit object spans several levels: 194,925 source questions, nine intended candidate paths per question, verifier verdicts and error reasons, ranked or regenerated accepted paths, summaries, and three final SFT views. These units must not be collapsed. A formatted row is neither an independently sourced medical question nor independent clinical validation, and an answer-level Correct verdict does not establish every intermediate claim.

医学推理 SFT 需要的不只是正确的选择题字母：有用记录还应解释临床因素、排除干扰项，同时避免加入无依据的医学陈述。单教师蒸馏可能重复同一模型的知识缺口，而全部使用最强专有模型生成又成本高。ReasonMed 研究能否通过互补教师、以答案键为条件的判定，以及按难度分配修复策略，较低成本地构造大规模开放推理语料。

审计对象跨越多个层级：194,925 道源题、每题拟生成的九条候选路径、验证器判定与错误原因、经过排序或再生成的接纳路径、摘要，以及三种最终 SFT 视图。这些单位不能混为一谈。一个格式化行既不等于一个独立来源的医学问题，也不等于独立临床验证；答案级 Correct 判定更不能证明每个中间陈述都正确。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ReasonMed combines three initial teachers—Qwen2.5-72B, HuatuoGPT-o1-70B, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B. Each produces three six-part paths at temperatures 0.7, 0.9, and 1.0. Qwen2.5-72B sees the question, choices, known answer, and candidate rationale, then emits a Correct/Error verdict plus a short reason. The number of errors among nine paths defines Easy (0–4 errors), Medium (5–7), and Difficult (8–9) routing.

Easy items retain two Qwen-ranked correct paths. Medium items retain two paths and use GPT-4o-mini to edit the portions implicated by verifier feedback. Difficult items use GPT-o1 to generate a new six-part rationale. GPT-4o-mini then summarizes accepted rationales. This yields CoTMed (rationale), ReasonMed (the CoT inside think tags followed by its summary), and ResponseMed (summary) SFT formulations.

The public scale is not three exact copies of 370K items. Dataset Server reports 370,022 CoTMed rows, 369,983 ReasonMed rows, and 371,550 ResponseMed rows, totaling 1,111,555 in one train split. Rows contain only instruction, input, and output; input is blank in inspected examples. Without stable source or pairing IDs, one-to-one alignment among the three views cannot be confirmed.

ReasonMed 组合了三个初始教师：Qwen2.5-72B、HuatuoGPT-o1-70B 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B。每个模型分别在温度 0.7、0.9 和 1.0 下生成三条六部分推理路径。Qwen2.5-72B 读取问题、选项、已知答案和候选推理，输出 Correct/Error 判定及简短原因。九条路径中的错误数决定 Easy（0–4 个错误）、Medium（5–7）或 Difficult（8–9）路由。

Easy 题保留由 Qwen 排名前二的正确路径；Medium 题保留两条路径，并由 GPT-4o-mini 针对验证器指出的部分进行修改；Difficult 题由 GPT-o1 重新生成一条六部分推理。随后，GPT-4o-mini 为接纳的推理生成摘要，形成 CoTMed（完整推理）、ReasonMed（把 CoT 放在 think 标签内并在其后附摘要）和 ResponseMed（摘要）三种 SFT 表示。

公开规模并不是三套完全相同的 370K 数据。Dataset Server 报告 CoTMed 370,022 行、ReasonMed 369,983 行、ResponseMed 371,550 行，共 1,111,555 行，合并在一个 train split 中。每行只有 instruction、input 和 output；抽查记录中的 input 为空。由于没有稳定的来源或配对 ID，无法确认三种视图之间是否逐行一一对应。

title: Method
方法
html:
The source table contains MedQA train/dev (10,178/1,272), MedMCQA train (182,822), PubMedQA train/validation (450/50), and dev/validation portions of six medical MMLU subsets, for 194,925 questions. Named test splits are excluded. The generation prompt requires six parts: restate the question, identify clinical background, evaluate every choice, eliminate inconsistent choices, compare survivors, and give a final answer with a concise justification.

Nine initial paths are intended for each question. The released generator code fixes top-p at 0.9 and max output at 8,192 tokens for all three temperatures. The verifier is answer-key-conditioned and checks clinical factors, option coverage, logical connection to the supplied answer, and medical factual errors. Figure 4 records 1,291,181 Correct and 442,471 Error verdicts across 192,628 questions (1,733,652 paths), not all 194,925 listed source questions; the omitted 2,297 questions are not reconciled.

EMD routing allocates repair cost. Easy questions have five to nine Correct paths and keep the ranker's best two. Medium questions have two to four Correct paths; the Error Refiner gives GPT-4o-mini the original path, correct answer, and error reasons from other attempts, requesting targeted correction. Difficult questions have fewer than two Correct paths and are regenerated by GPT-o1. A separate Response Summarizer produces the concise view, while GPT-4o scores quality from 1 to 10 for analysis rather than supplying an executable medical truth predicate.

For downstream experiments, the paper fully fine-tunes Qwen2.5-7B for three epochs with learning rate 1e-5, cosine schedule, 10% warmup, 4,096-token context, bf16, DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, and 16 H20 GPUs; a 14B variant is also reported. Data generation takes about 122 hours, while 7B training uses 448 H20 GPU-hours. The selective EMD estimate is $4,552.47 versus $16,631 for direct GPT-o1 distillation under the paper's pricing assumptions.

The repository exposes generation, verification, ranking, refinement, summarization, and scoring scripts, but no end-to-end run manifest or source-preparation script. Current code also differs from the paper prompt in places: quality_ranker.py independently scores each path on 0–5 before sorting, and verifier defaults are stochastic (temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95). Training and evaluation remain marked “Stay tuned,” and no tagged release fixes the exact paper implementation.

源数据表包括 MedQA train/dev（10,178/1,272）、MedMCQA train（182,822）、PubMedQA train/validation（450/50），以及六个医学 MMLU 子集的 dev/validation，共 194,925 道题；具名 test split 被排除。生成 prompt 要求六个部分：改写问题、提取临床背景、评估每个选项、排除不一致选项、比较剩余选择，并给出最终答案与简明理由。

流程拟为每题生成九条初始路径。发布的生成脚本在三个温度下统一设置 top-p=0.9、最大输出 8,192 token。验证器以答案键为条件，检查关键临床因素、选项覆盖、推理是否导向给定答案，以及是否存在医学事实错误。Figure 4 记录了 192,628 道题上的 1,291,181 个 Correct 和 442,471 个 Error 判定，共 1,733,652 条路径，并未覆盖表中全部 194,925 道源题；缺少的 2,297 道题没有对账说明。

EMD 路由按难度分配修复成本。Easy 题有 5–9 条 Correct 路径，保留排序前二；Medium 题有 2–4 条 Correct 路径，Error Refiner 把原路径、正确答案和其他尝试的错误原因交给 GPT-4o-mini，要求定向纠错；Difficult 题不足两条 Correct 路径，由 GPT-o1 再生成。独立的 Response Summarizer 生成简洁视图；GPT-4o 的 1–10 分只用于质量分析，不是可执行的医学真值判据。

下游实验对 Qwen2.5-7B 进行 3 个 epoch 的全参数微调，学习率 1e-5、cosine schedule、10% warmup、4,096 token 上下文、bf16、DeepSpeed ZeRO-2，并使用 16 张 H20；论文还报告 14B 版本。数据生成约需 122 小时，7B 训练使用 448 H20 GPU-hours。按论文定价假设，选择性 EMD 估算成本为 4,552.47 美元，全部直接 GPT-o1 蒸馏为 16,631 美元。

仓库提供生成、验证、排序、修复、摘要和评分脚本，但没有端到端 run manifest 或源数据准备脚本。当前代码在部分位置也与论文 prompt 不同：quality_ranker.py 先逐路径给出 0–5 分再排序，验证器默认采用随机设置（temperature 1.0、top-p 0.95）。训练与评测仍标为“Stay tuned”，仓库也没有 tag 固定论文对应实现。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The GPT-4o Score Evaluator assigns 1,000 Medium-pipeline paths an average 7.37 before refinement and 8.17 after refinement. In cross-dataset samples it gives ReasonMed 8.45 for 1,000 rows and 8.50 for 3,000, versus 8.03 for medical-o1-reasoning-SFT and 8.18 for Medical-R1-Distill-Data. Because the evaluator is another LLM and the paper does not report blinded expert adjudication of these comparisons, these scores support the pipeline's own rubric, not clinical correctness.

Reported SFT results separate the three views. After three epochs, ResponseMed-7B, CoTMed-7B, and ReasonMed-7B reach aggregate accuracy 67.0, 69.1, and 69.6 across nine medical QA benchmarks; their average outputs are about 225, 555, and 626 tokens. ReasonMed-14B reaches 72.8 versus 69.0 for the Qwen2.5-14B baseline under the paper's evaluation. These model results show training utility, but cannot validate each rationale or distinguish scale, teacher, formatting, and contamination effects.

The 100-case board-certified-physician pilot reports structured reasoning in 87%, systematic distractor elimination in 82%, and core-medical-concept use in 78%. It simultaneously finds insufficient external citations in 68%, missing clinical specifics in 35%, and redundancy/verbosity in 21%. The paper does not disclose the number of physicians, review instructions, agreement, adjudication, specialties, or confidence intervals; its Responsible NLP Checklist marks human annotators as not used despite this pilot.

The public artifact provides direct counter-evidence to a blanket “high quality” interpretation. An early released row explains that none of four vitamin deficiencies causes Rett's syndrome, yet still suggests Biotin if forced to choose. Another says every OPV statement is true but nevertheless picks an exception. Appendix A.8 presents non-cherry-picked generations for one glomerular-capillary question whose final answer changes among options across temperatures. These are internally observable inconsistencies; no external clinical diagnosis is required to see that the records need item-level review.

Release inspection confirms a substantial artifact—three JSON files totaling about 3.07 GB and 1,111,555 rows—but also confirms missing lineage and unequal counts. Official links, counts, and executable modules establish release existence and recipe evidence; benchmark gains and LLM scores do not prove medical safety or source-license compatibility.

GPT-4o Score Evaluator 对 1,000 条 Medium 路径的平均评分在修复前为 7.37、修复后为 8.17。跨数据集抽样中，ReasonMed 的 1,000 行和 3,000 行样本分别得到 8.45 和 8.50，medical-o1-reasoning-SFT 为 8.03，Medical-R1-Distill-Data 为 8.18。由于评估器仍是另一个 LLM，且论文未报告对这些比较进行盲法专家裁决，这些分数只能支持该流程自身的 rubric，不能证明临床正确性。

论文分别报告三种视图的 SFT 结果。训练 3 个 epoch 后，ResponseMed-7B、CoTMed-7B 与 ReasonMed-7B 在九个医学 QA benchmark 上的综合准确率为 67.0、69.1 和 69.6，平均输出长度约为 225、555 和 626 token。ReasonMed-14B 达到 72.8，而论文中的 Qwen2.5-14B baseline 为 69.0。这些模型结果说明数据具有训练效用，但无法逐条验证推理，也无法分离规模、教师、格式和污染的影响。

100 例 board-certified physician pilot 报告：87% 具有结构化推理，82% 系统排除了干扰项，78% 使用了核心医学概念；同时，68% 缺少充分外部引用，35% 缺少临床细节，21% 存在重复或冗长。论文没有披露医生人数、审查说明、一致性、仲裁、专科或置信区间；其 Responsible NLP Checklist 尽管包含该 pilot，却把“使用人类标注者”标为否。

公开产物本身为笼统的“高质量”解释提供了直接反证。发布开头的一条记录先说明四种维生素缺乏都不会导致 Rett's syndrome，却又在被迫选择时建议 Biotin；另一条记录说关于 OPV 的所有陈述都正确，却仍选出一个“例外”。Appendix A.8 展示了同一肾小球毛细血管问题的非 cherry-picked 输出，不同温度下最终选项发生变化。这些都是可直接观察的内部不一致，无需外部临床诊断即可确认记录需要逐项复核。

发布检查证明确有大规模产物：三个 JSON 文件合计约 3.07 GB、1,111,555 行；同时也证实谱系缺失和计数不等长。官方链接、计数和可执行模块能证明发布与配方存在，但 benchmark 增益和 LLM 分数不能证明医学安全或源许可兼容。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
ReasonMed's distinctive construction choice is selective escalation. It does not spend GPT-o1 on every question: nine locally generated paths estimate difficulty, easy cases are ranked, medium cases receive verifier-guided edits, and only the difficult tail is regenerated. The paper then exposes long rationale, summary, and hybrid views to compare supervision granularity and output cost from a related content pool.

This is more explicit than single-pass medical distillation, but it is still answer-key-conditioned synthetic supervision. The verifier, ranker, refiner, and evaluator are not independent clinical authorities, and the released three-field rows discard the decisions that make the EMD recipe auditable. Novelty in routing and representation should not be read as proof of medical factuality or faithful reasoning.

ReasonMed 的关键构造选择是选择性升级处理。它没有对每道题都调用 GPT-o1，而是先用九条本地生成路径估计难度：Easy 题只排序，Medium 题接受验证器引导的修改，只有困难长尾才重新生成。随后，论文把相关内容发布为长推理、摘要和混合三种视图，以比较监督粒度与输出成本。

这比单次医学蒸馏更明确，但仍属于以答案键为条件的合成监督。验证器、排序器、修复器和评估器都不是独立临床权威；公开的三字段记录还丢弃了使 EMD 配方可审计的中间决策。因此，路由和表示上的新意不能被理解为医学事实正确或推理忠实的证明。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Quality control is dominated by correlated LLM judgments. Qwen2.5-72B both verifies and ranks against a supplied answer; GPT-4o-mini edits using those error logs; GPT-4o later scores outputs. A wrong or ambiguous source answer can therefore anchor all stages. Prompts encourage exhaustive detail and even references to guidelines or quantitative evidence, but there is no retrieval/citation grounding layer, and answer-level acceptance does not validate individual claims.

The physician pilot is too small and underdocumented for corpus-wide clinical validation. Its own findings—68% insufficient citations, 35% missing clinical specifics, 21% verbosity—are material failure rates. Public examples also contain internally contradictory forced-choice reasoning, and Appendix A.8 shows unstable final answers across temperatures. The paper's ethical statement restricts use to academic research and advises against clinical deployment.

Counts and lineage cannot be reconciled from the release. The source table totals 194,925 questions, while Figures 4 and 6 account for 192,628. The intended nine paths would be 1,754,325, but the verdict figure covers 1,733,652. Final files contain 370,022, 369,983, and 371,550 rows rather than equal views. There are no per-record source IDs, answer keys, generator/temperature fields, verdicts, difficulty tiers, rejected paths, or cross-view IDs, so omissions, duplication, and view mapping cannot be audited.

Reproduction is version-fragile. The repository has no tags/releases or license file; training/evaluation code and public checkpoints are not available. Its current Quality Ranker and decoding defaults are not identical to the paper description, and no immutable manifest binds paper data to code, local model revisions, Azure model deployments, prompts, seeds, failures, and retries. API model aliases and costs can change.

Only named test splits were excluded. Semantic overlap with evaluation items, duplicate questions across sources, model-pretraining contamination, and answer leakage are not reported. The HF top-level Apache-2.0 label does not by itself establish compatible rights for every MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, or MMLU-derived question. The checklist marks artifact licensing, intended-use compatibility, and data documentation as N/A, leaving source-level redistribution analysis unresolved.

质量控制主要依赖相关的 LLM 判定。Qwen2.5-72B 同时依据给定答案进行验证和排序，GPT-4o-mini 使用这些错误日志修复，GPT-4o 再为输出打分。因此，一个错误或歧义的源答案可能锚定整个流程。Prompt 鼓励穷尽细节，甚至要求引用指南或定量证据，但流程没有检索/引用 grounding 层；答案级接纳也不能验证每个陈述。

医生 pilot 规模太小、记录太少，不能作为全语料临床验证。其自身发现——68% 引用不足、35% 缺少临床细节、21% 冗长——是实质性失败比例。公开样本还含有内部矛盾的强制选择推理，Appendix A.8 也显示最终答案随温度不稳定。论文 ethical statement 将用途限制为学术研究，并明确不建议临床部署。

发布无法对账计数和谱系。源表共 194,925 道题，而 Figure 4/6 只覆盖 192,628 道；按每题九条应为 1,754,325 条，但判定图只有 1,733,652 条。三个最终文件分别为 370,022、369,983 和 371,550 行，并非等长视图。公开数据没有逐记录来源 ID、答案键、生成器/温度、判定、难度层、被拒路径或跨视图 ID，因此无法审计遗漏、重复和视图映射。

复现容易受版本漂移影响。仓库没有 tag/release 或 LICENSE，训练/评测代码和公开 checkpoint 也不可用。当前 Quality Ranker 与解码默认值并不完全等同论文描述，没有不可变 manifest 把论文数据绑定到代码、本地模型版本、Azure 部署、prompt、随机种子、失败和重试。API 模型别名与成本也会变化。

论文只排除了具名 test split，没有报告与评测项的语义重叠、跨来源重复题、模型预训练污染或答案泄漏。HF 顶层 Apache-2.0 标签本身不能证明每一道源自 MedQA、MedMCQA、PubMedQA 或 MMLU 的题目都具备兼容权利。Checklist 还把 artifact 许可、用途兼容与数据文档标为 N/A，因此来源级再分发分析仍未解决。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track, ReasonMed is a concrete template for budgeted domain-data synthesis: enumerate source splits, sample complementary teachers, use answer-key-conditioned error logs, estimate difficulty from pass counts, escalate repair selectively, and materialize alternative SFT views. Its code modules make individual stages inspectable even though the exact paper run is not turnkey reproducible.

CoTMed can support long-rationale SFT and error analysis; ResponseMed supports concise answer-explanation SFT; ReasonMed supports models that emit hidden-style reasoning followed by a user-facing summary. The unequal counts and absent IDs mean these should be treated as separate files, not assumed paired counterfactual views. The release is also useful for studying whether summary supervision captures similar benchmark utility with fewer output tokens.

High-risk reuse requires a stronger data contract. Add source dataset and original-question IDs, answer/version provenance, teacher and sampling metadata, verifier/refiner outputs, difficulty, rejected paths, and cross-view IDs. Revalidate source questions and all clinical claims with independent references and qualified reviewers; measure inter-reviewer agreement; preserve abstention when options are invalid; build source-level license and decontamination manifests; and keep a held-out question-family split.

ReasonMed is suitable for research on SFT recipes, judge auditing, provenance recovery, and medical-data failure analysis. It is not clinical advice, a patient-facing corpus, or evidence that long chain-of-thought is medically faithful merely because downstream accuracy improves.

对 Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track 而言，ReasonMed 是一套具体的预算化领域数据合成模板：列明源划分、从互补教师采样、利用答案键条件下的错误日志、根据通过数量估计难度、选择性升级修复，并生成多种 SFT 视图。其代码模块让单个阶段可检查，但论文对应的完整 run 不能一键复现。

CoTMed 可用于长推理 SFT 与错误分析，ResponseMed 可用于简洁答案解释 SFT，ReasonMed 可训练先生成 hidden-style 推理再给用户摘要的模型。由于三个文件计数不等且没有 ID，应把它们视为独立文件，不能默认是配对的反事实视图。该发布还适合研究摘要监督能否用更少输出 token 获得相近 benchmark 效用。

高风险复用需要更强的数据契约：补充源数据集和原题 ID、答案/版本来源、教师与采样元数据、验证器/修复器输出、难度、被拒路径及跨视图 ID；使用独立参考资料和合格评审者重新核验源题与全部医学陈述；测量评审一致性；在选项无效时允许 abstention；建立来源级许可与去污染 manifest，并保留按题族划分的测试集。

ReasonMed 适合研究 SFT 配方、判定器审计、谱系恢复和医学数据失败分析。它不是临床建议或患者语料，也不能因为下游准确率提高就被视为长 chain-of-thought 医学忠实性的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Distinguish 194,925 source questions, nine intended paths, 1,291,181 Correct verdicts, approximately 370K accepted rationales, and 1,111,555 formatted rows.
  • Figures 4/6 cover 192,628 questions, 2,297 fewer than the source table; the paper does not reconcile the gap.
  • CoTMed, ReasonMed, and ResponseMed have 370,022, 369,983, and 371,550 rows and no public pairing ID.
  • The verifier sees the supplied answer; judge agreement is not independent clinical evidence, and public rows retain no verdict or error log.
  • Physician review finds 68% citation insufficiency and 35% missing clinical specifics, while its reviewer protocol remains undisclosed.
  • Use only for research: recheck invalid options, medical claims, lineage, contamination, and source licenses before training or redistribution.

• 区分 194,925 道源题、每题拟生成的九条路径、1,291,181 个 Correct 判定、约 370K 条接纳推理与 1,111,555 个格式化行。
  • Figure 4/6 只覆盖 192,628 道题，比源表少 2,297 道；论文没有对账该差额。
  • CoTMed、ReasonMed 和 ResponseMed 分别为 370,022、369,983 和 371,550 行，且没有公开配对 ID。
  • 验证器能看到给定答案；judge 一致不等于独立临床证据，公开行也不保留判定或错误日志。
  • 医生审查发现 68% 引用不足、35% 缺少临床细节，但评审协议仍未披露。
  • 仅用于研究；训练或再发布前重审无效选项、医学陈述、谱系、污染和源许可。

items: Answer-key-conditioned LLM judges can approve plausible rationales with unsupported or incorrect intermediate medical claims
The same Qwen2.5-72B family verifies and ranks, creating correlated selection errors
Invalid, outdated, or ambiguous source questions can survive while generated text is forced toward a supplied option
The three public views have unequal row counts and no stable identifier for one-to-one alignment
Pilot physician review covers only 100 cases and omits reviewer count, instructions, agreement, and adjudication details
Long rationales can state that none of the options is correct and still recommend an option, or invoke uncited guidelines and studies
答案键条件化的 LLM 评审可能批准带有无支持或不正确中间医学主张的看似合理理由
同一 Qwen2.5-72B 族既验证又排序，造成相关的选择错误
无效、过时或含糊的来源问题可能存活，同时生成文本被强制指向所给选项
三个公开视图行数不等，且无一对一对齐的稳定标识符
试点医师审查仅覆盖 100 例，并省略审查者数量、说明、一致性与裁决细节
长理由可声称没有任何选项正确却仍推荐某一选项，或援引未引用的指南与研究
